In the foreground, two men wearing blue shirts and dark shorts are wading through water, guiding a wooden plow pulled by two oxen (or water buffalo). The plow consists of a long wooden beam (yoke/handle) and a metal share digging into the mud. In the background, there is another person, a small hut with a blue tarp roof, and green vegetation on a hillside. The water reflects the subjects clearly.
